text:
I’m still working on https://feedsync.net, a tool to push RSS feed updates to Discord.

It’s been getting a decent number of sign ups despite me not really posting it anywhere or doing any marketing.

Ultimately a fun project, and useful for myself and a few friends, so I’m happy others are even interested in trying it.

I’ve started to regret using Phoenix LiveView, as it’s only deployed in one region, so high latency far from there. I’m exploring a SPA as a better alternative.

Otherwise, I’ve been playing around with a Lua engine to build feeds for websites that don’t support them, using AI to build the Lua as a once-off. It works reasonably well, but isn’t ready for prime time just yet.
